request.style: English, narrative female solo voice with warm gospel choir, acoustic guitar, cello, percussion, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Son of man set your face against Gog
Chief prince of Meshech and Tubal
The word of the Lord came to me
I am against you I declare

[Chorus]
I will turn you around with a hook
Bring you out with your whole army
Horses and horsemen splendidly clothed
A vast company with shields

[Verse]
Persia and Cush and Put are with them
Gomer and Beth Togarmah from the north
Many peoples gathered around you
Prepare yourself for the battle

[Chorus]
I will turn you around with a hook
Bring you out with your whole army
Horses and horsemen splendidly clothed
A vast company with shields

[Verse]
In the latter years you will invade
A land that has recovered from war
People gathered to the mountains of Israel
Living in safety and peace

[Pre-Chorus]
You will come like a storm on the land
A cloud covering the sky
Thinking in your heart an evil scheme
To plunder the unwalled villages

[Chorus]
I will turn you around with a hook
Bring you out with your whole army
Horses and horsemen splendidly clothed
A vast company with shields

[Bridge]
My hot anger will flare up that day
A great earthquake in the land
Mountains will be torn down and fall
The sword against his brother

[Verse]
I will pour down rain and hailstones
Fire and sulfur on you
Show my greatness and my holiness
They will know that I am the Lord

[Outro]
Seven months they will bury the dead
Cleansing the land for the Lord
Valley of Gog's Horde it shall be
Fire from heaven consumes them
